title.en: Foreign Capital – FDI, FPI, FII, QFI
title.hi: Foreign Capital – FDI, FPI, FII, QFI

definition.en: Foreign capital refers to the inflow of funds from abroad into the domestic economy, categorized primarily into direct and portfolio investments.
definition.hi: Foreign capital refers to the inflow of funds from abroad into the domestic economy, categorized primarily into direct and portfolio investments.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is central to the GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section. Understanding these capital flows is essential for analyzing Balance of Payments, exchange rate stability, and government policies regarding liberalization and capital account convertibility.
importanceInUpsc.hi: This topic is central to the GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section. Understanding these capital flows is essential for analyzing Balance of Payments, exchange rate stability, and government policies regarding liberalization and capital account convertibility.

learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish between long-term direct investment and short-term portfolio investment.
learningOutcomes.hi: Distinguish between long-term direct investment and short-term portfolio investment.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of foreign capital inflows on the Indian economy and domestic financial markets.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the impact of foreign capital inflows on the Indian economy and domestic financial markets.
